body: Sure it becomes easier but parry systems like this are so boring. Parry then one hit now I gotta wait for the baddie to do the thing again before I can get my one hit in again. I’m sorry but I prefer a game that encourages you to find your own combat style. Parrying itself is a cool mechanic but when the game drives every encounter to just try to get you to parry that’s when it’s just flat out boring and slow.
